One of these tumblers cost four times the other. Real cut crystal has sharp, precise facets and throws small rainbows in direct light. Pressed glass has smooth, rounded panels with no faceting at all. Run a finger along the rim before you buy. Crystal feels crisp and angular. Glass feels smooth all the way round. Comment if you guessed right before the reveal.
